selection: 8 fitting and 4 checks fixed before first fit; no tuning against checks
pixel_convention: Continuous image coordinates; upper-left outer corner=(0,0); x right, y down; pixel centers at n+0.5. Coordinates rounded to integer pixel-edge units, manual precision ~10–30 pixels, town symbol extent often larger. Source 13949 x 9524.
inspection: Whole image and enlarged crops inspected, followed by original-resolution 500 x 500 crops with crosshairs. Enlarged regional views used crop offset + displayed coordinate * original_crop_dimension/display_dimension. Final positions checked against original pixel coordinates in annotated crops.
acceptance: Legacy proxies retained for reproduction, NOT accepted exact historical geographic controls. GNIS populated-place centers are not verified colonial settlement locations.
